title: The Project Environment
coreMove: Use context as live project data: scan internal culture and assets before checking regulation, technology, and markets, then choose practices that fit the work now.

exampleSpecs.audience: project leads tempted to copy a familiar plan
exampleSpecs.stakes: an old template may hide a supplier handoff risk
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Octave works through the urge to copy the asset and then tests it against current enterprise conditions.

exampleSpecs.domain: compliance and platform planning before work starts
exampleSpecs.stakes: three external signals compete for one planning block
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Lucie allocates scarce attention among a regulatory update, cybersecurity review, and platform capability assessment before anyone executes.

exampleSpecs.domain: software release affected by compliance change
exampleSpecs.stakes: both release choices carry visible harm
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Ren faces two bad options after a regulatory update changes cybersecurity evidence for the release.

exampleSpecs.domain: PMO review of reusable project material
exampleSpecs.audience: sponsors and PMO leads deciding how much process to reuse
exampleSpecs.stakes: a helpful archive may become rigid copying
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Leon and Giulia separate enterprise environmental factors from organizational process assets in conversation.

exampleSpecs.domain: procurement review after a promising technology update
exampleSpecs.stakes: a platform shortcut appears to save time but creates a supplier exposure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Marguerite expects the new platform capability to reduce work, then discovers a supply disruption that changes feasibility.

exampleSpecs.audience: distributed teams catching environmental shifts midstream
exampleSpecs.stakes: short messages must surface an external change before a routine meeting locks the wrong agenda
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Lucas uses a short message exchange to turn supply disruption and platform capability signals into a live agenda change.
